title: [storage] the real bytes on disk of each storage source, read once a day by the loop outside every owner hold, each extent counted once (storage-extents.py, host.storage_bytes): the reading the storage north star and S1 (185) are measured from
prompt:
Spawn, objective 180 [storage] (after 176; the owner's core metric set of 2026-11-14 18:42, the lead's split of 180 into 180 and 185): the real bytes on disk of each storage source, read once a day, each extent counted once, outside every owner hold.

The storage line steers by "Bytes a landing leaves behind" (the north star) and "Rebuildable bytes on disk" (S1). 176 shows both as "not measured yet". Both need what each source really holds on disk. An apparent size says nothing on btrfs: a reflinked copy shares its data. The lead's storage study (exp3.py) counts each physical extent once. This objective takes that reading and records it daily. 185 measures the two figures from it, and 184 takes S2.

Base: 176 R2 (rev-g, sync/obj-176's throwaway, 3687ed74..2390a454 on live main 007563ed, the rewritten history; here n180 744b5311). R1 was on 176 01ee71ef (old history); moved by content (rebased 2026-11-15, the lead's step 11).

Read first:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/storage.rs: `Sampler`, `session_backup_status`, `session_backup_bytes`, `projects_path`;
- crates/spawn-cli/src/core_lines_sample.rs: `Reading`, `Sampler::check_with` (a reading on its own thread, given up after a limit);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/unowned.rs: `settings` (storage.scratch_roots, scratch_exclude);
- crates/spawn-postgres/src/host.rs: `host_record`, `HOST_STORAGE`; crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql: spawn_host_record's `host.storage`, its fold and index;
- deploy/deploy.sh: the relays installed into $live/bin.

What changes:
(1) scripts/storage-extents.py (new; the owner's). Run as `python3 -I -B`, it reads its config as JSON on stdin: `{"bound_secs", "sources": [{"name", "roots", "exclude"}]}`.
   - It walks each source's roots. Symbolic links are never followed, and an excluded directory is never entered.
   - It asks the file system for each regular file's extents (FIEMAP through fcntl.ioctl, FIEMAP_FLAG_SYNC). The file is opened O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and never read.
   - It prints `{"sources": [{"name", "bytes", "files", "unreadable", "seconds"} | {"name", "over_bound": true, "files", "seconds"}]}`.
   - An extent is counted once across the whole reading, in the first source that holds it: a reflinked copy adds nothing, a plain copy adds its bytes. Inline data counts as its length.
   - A source not done within bound_secs reads over_bound, never a partial count.
   - It never prints a name, path or content.
   deploy/deploy.sh installs it next to the binary in $live/bin, where the binary looks for it. Nothing is restarted.
(2) A control record, `host.storage_bytes`, written through spawn_host_record (owner only): `{"sources": {<name>: {"bytes": <n>, ...} | {"not_measured": <why>}}}`. Any other shape is refused. It folds into no table, and a partial index finds it (`spawn_events_host_storage_bytes`, on session_seq). The store reads it back with `host_storage_bytes()`: the newest reading `{at_ms, sources}` and the database's clock.
(3) crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes.rs (new): the loop's `Sampler`, wired into `spawn loop` beside the storage and Core lines samples. Each reading holds six sources:
   - transcripts, build_cache and scratch, through the script, extents counted in that order:
     - transcripts: the archive `<root>/.transcripts` and Claude Code's projects directory;
     - build_cache: `$XDG_CACHE_HOME`, else `$HOME/.cache`;
     - scratch: the Core lines file's storage.scratch_roots less its storage.scratch_exclude;
     A source with no root (no scratch roots set) is not measured, and says so.
   - session_backups: the status file's estimated_bytes (097; their tree is root's);
   - test_databases: each configured test database's size, each database once by name;
   - live_database: the live database's size.
   Further rules:
   - The script runs at `nice -n 19`, on a thread of its own, never inside a pass. It is stopped after one hour, and every source it reads is then not measured, with why. The bound is 1200 s per source.
   - The script is the one `SPAWN_STORAGE_EXTENTS` names, else the one beside the binary.
   - A reading is due when the newest recorded one is a day old, by the database's clock. A restarted loop does not read again.
   - No reading starts while the owner holds any source (`spawn hold`), or while the quiet-hold file is set and cannot be read or its first line is not `ENDED`.
     - The file is set by the Core lines file's `storage.quiet_hold_file`, else by `SPAWN_QUIET_HOLD_FILE`. Neither set: no such check. (The lead sets it in core-lines.json after landing; the product names no path of its own.)
     - Nothing is recorded during a hold: an all-not-measured reading must never take the day's slot. The loop logs "storage bytes: not measured (owner gate): <why>" and looks again 10 minutes later.
   - A hold that begins while the script runs stops it.
   - A reading that cannot be taken or written is a line in the loop's log, never a failed pass. It is tried again 10 minutes later.

What stays as it is: every figure (185 measures the north star and S1 from these readings, and until then they stay "not measured yet"); the `host.storage` samples and the storage report; no gate, integrator or deploy step reads the readings.

Cost, measured on live with the lead's study rule, nice'd (sync/obj-180 has the script I timed with):
- scratch (/data/tmp less /data/tmp/ccd-pg): 752,133 files, 50.87 GB real, 92.3 s;
- build cache (~/.cache): 151,891 files, 27.87 GB real, 14.1 s;
- transcripts: 511 files, 1.31 GB real, 0.2 s.
That is about 107 s once a day, at nice 19, outside the owner's gates.
Polled reads: none per pass. The sampler reads `host_storage_bytes()` (newest reading, through its index) only when due: once a day, and every 10 minutes during a hold. Read-only timing on live:
  psql "$SPAWN_DATABASE_URL" -c "explain analyze select e.session_seq from spawn_events e where e.session_id = 'session_control' and e.event_name = 'control.recorded' and e.kind -> 'detail' -> 'record' ->> 'type' = 'host.storage_bytes' order by e.session_seq desc limit 1"
Expected under 1 ms once the index exists; the lead times it.

Tests:
- storage_bytes.rs:
  - a_reading_waits_for_every_owner_hold;
  - the_scripts_input_lists_the_sources_in_their_counting_order;
  - a_source_over_its_bound_or_unread_is_not_measured;
  - the_test_databases_count_each_database_once;
  - the_script_is_run_bounded_and_stoppable (a fake script under python3: its answer, a failure, no JSON, its limit, a stop);
  - the_extents_script_gives_no_partial_count_past_its_bound (the real script: over its bound no bytes; an empty root 0);
  - a_reading_is_taken_daily_outside_every_hold.
- crates/spawn-postgres/tests/storage.rs: storage_readings_are_recorded_and_the_newest_read_back (shapes refused, no table, the newest, the index used in a stream of 5,000 other records).

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes.rs (new), crates/spawn-cli/src/main.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/commands/loops.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/core_lines_sample.rs (a test helper), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (three readers of the Core lines file), crates/spawn-postgres/src/host.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql, crates/spawn-postgres/tests/storage.rs. The owner's (180-owner.diff): scripts/storage-extents.py (new), deploy/deploy.sh (the install), rsi/scenarios/180.sh (new). None is shared with an open objective of mine; 185 stacks on it.
Size: fleet +1001 −1: code about +570 (storage_bytes.rs 487, host.rs +25, schema +23, core_lines.rs +23, loops.rs +12, main.rs 1), tests about +430 (storage_bytes.rs 323, the store test 96, a test helper 10); owner +460 (storage-extents.py 118, deploy.sh +6, 180.sh 336). Over the bar, accepted by the lead as one piece with the size said here.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/180.sh is a black box through `spawn loop`'s records and its log, on a temp tree under TMPDIR. It needs a file system with reflinks; without one it is a harness failure.
- scratch: a 4 MiB file, its reflinked copy, its plain copy, and an excluded directory holding 2 MiB;
- build cache: a 1 MiB file, reflinked into scratch;
- transcripts: 256 KiB in the archive and 256 KiB in Claude Code's projects;
- a reading seeded two days ago;
- the Core lines file names the scratch root, its exclude and the quiet-hold file.
(1) While the quiet-hold file says IN PROGRESS, the loop takes no reading and logs "storage bytes: not measured (owner gate)".
(2) With it ENDED, the loop records a reading:
   - scratch is 8 MiB: the file and its plain copy, never its reflink, the excluded directory or the build cache's reflink;
   - build_cache is 1 MiB;
   - transcripts is 512 KiB;
   - test_databases is 0 (none configured);
   - session_backups is not measured (no status file).
(3) A loop started again within the day takes no second reading.
On the base (176, 01ee71ef), 180.sh exits 1: "(1) the loop did not say, within 60 s, that a hold put the reading off", "(2) the loop recorded no host.storage_bytes reading within 120 s of its start".
